blocks.title: Vectors
blocks.text: Vectors woh physical quantities hain jin ki mukammal wazahat ke liye miqdar ke saath simt (direction) bhi chahiye.

blocks.caption: Vectors ki misalein
rows: kisi cheez ki jagah mein tabdeeli: faasla (magnitude) aur simt
kisi khaas simt mein cheez ki speed
velocity ki tabdeeli ki raftar, speed ya simt ya dono mein
kisi cheez par dhakka ya kheench, apni miqdar aur simt se tay

blocks.text: Vector quantity dikhane ka achha tareeqa vector diagram hai, jis mein vectors teeron (arrows) se dikhaye jate hain: teer ki lambai miqdar batati hai aur teer ka sira vector ki simt. Vectors aam taur par mote (bold) harfon (V, F) ya symbol ke oopar teer ke sire se likhe jate hain.

Vector ka component kisi di gayi simt mein us ki muassir qeemat hai. Vector ko muqarrar simton mein apne component vectors ka resultant samjha ja sakta hai, aur aam taur par vector ko ek doosre par amood (perpendicular) simton mein components mein torna aasan hota hai; aise components rectangular components kehlate hain. Farz karein vector A lakeer OP se dikhaya gaya hai jo x-axis se zawiya theta banati hai. A ka x-axis par projection OM aur y-axis par projection ON kheenchein (Fig. 2.1). x-simt mein projection OM ko Ax aur y-simt mein projection ON ko Ay se dikhaya jata hai. Head-to-tail qaide se A = Ax + Ay ... (2.1). Yun Ax aur Ay vector A ke components hain, aur chunke yeh ek doosre par amood hain, yeh A ke rectangular components hain. Right-angled triangle OMP se Ax, yani x-component, ki miqdar Ax = A cos theta ... (2.2) hai, aur Ay, yani y-component, ki miqdar Ay = A sin theta ... (2.3).

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: O se P tak zawiya theta par vector A apne components Ax (M tak) aur Ay (N tak) aur component formulas ke saath. Oopar darmiyan: ek hi asal se A aur B, A par B cos theta ka projection aur dot-product formulas. Oopar daen: ek satah mein A aur B jin se A x B right-hand rule se satah se bahar nikalta hai. Neeche: scalar aur vector misalein, dono products ki khusoosiyat, torque, magnetic force aur Example 2.1.
blocks.caption: Vectors: rectangular components, scalar product aur vector product (Figures 2.1 se 2.4 aur topics 2.1 se 2.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Asal se x-axis ke zawiye par kheencha vector do amood components ka majmooa hai, x ke saath miqdar zarb zawiye ka cosine aur y ke saath miqdar zarb sine, aur components se miqdar aur simt Pythagoras aur tangent se wapas milti hain. Do vectors ka scalar product un ki miqdaron aur darmiyani zawiye ke cosine ka hasil-e-zarb hai, jo ek miqdar zarb doosre ka us par projection ke barabar hai, is liye yeh commutative hai, amood vectors ke liye sifr, mutawazi ke liye miqdaron ka hasil-e-zarb aur vector ka khud se product miqdar ka muraba; kiya gaya kaam force aur displacement ka scalar product hai. Vector product ki miqdar miqdaron aur zawiye ke sine ka hasil-e-zarb hai, yeh right-hand rule se dono vectors ki satah par amood hota hai, tarteeb ulatne par nishan badalta hai, mutawazi vectors ke liye sifr hai, un ke bane parallelogram ke raqbe ke barabar hai, aur torque aur chalte charge par magnetic force deta hai.

blocks.text: Rectangular components se vector maloom karna

Agar vector ke rectangular components (Fig. 2.1) diye hon to vector ki miqdar Pythagorean theorem se milti hai. Right-angled triangle OMP mein (OP)^2 = (OM)^2 + (MP)^2, ya A^2 = Ax^2 + Ay^2 ... (2.4), ya A = sqrt(Ax^2 + Ay^2). Simt theta tan theta = MP/OM = Ay/Ax se milti hai, ya theta = tan^-1 (Ay/Ax) ... (2.5).

blocks.title: Example 2.1
blocks.text: Barabar miqdar ki do forces ke darmiyan zawiya nikalein jab un ke resultant ki miqdar bhi har force ki miqdar ke barabar ho. Hal: farz karein F1 aur F2 ke darmiyan zawiya theta hai, F1 x-axis ke saath. Resultant ka x-component Rx = F1 cos 0 + F2 cos theta = F1 + F2 cos theta hai, aur y-component Ry = F1 sin 0 + F2 sin theta = F2 sin theta. Resultant R, R^2 = Rx^2 + Ry^2 se milta hai. Chunke R = F1 = F2 = F, F^2 = (F + F cos theta)^2 + (F sin theta)^2 = F^2 + F^2 cos^2 theta + 2 F^2 cos theta + F^2 sin^2 theta, ya 0 = 2 F^2 cos theta + F^2 (cos^2 theta + sin^2 theta) = 2 F^2 cos theta + F^2, to cos theta = -0.5 aur theta = cos^-1 (-0.5) = 120 degrees.

blocks.caption: Vector ke components
rows: Ax = A cos theta, Ay = A sin theta

blocks.prompt: 20 N ki force ufuq (horizontal) se 60 degrees oopar lagti hai. Us ke rectangular components nikalein, phir un se miqdar aur simt wapas hasil karein.
blocks.explanation: Fx = 20 cos 60 = 10 N aur Fy = 20 sin 60 = 17.3 N. Wapas: F = sqrt(10^2 + 17.3^2) = sqrt(100 + 300) = 20 N, aur theta = tan^-1 (17.3/10) = tan^-1 (1.73) = 60 degrees.

items: Vector: miqdar aur simt (displacement, velocity, acceleration, force); teer se dikhaya, bold ya symbol par teer se likha.

Rectangular components: A = Ax + Ay, Ax = A cos theta, Ay = A sin theta; wapas: A = sqrt(Ax^2 + Ay^2), theta = tan^-1 (Ay/Ax). Example 2.1: barabar forces jin ka resultant barabar ho 120 degrees par hoti hain.
